ANSWER: NO
HALLUCINATIONS: None

The memo accurately represents all key financial terms found in the source document. All major elements are properly supported:

- Date (December 7, 2020)
- Borrower name (Open Lending, LLC, Texas LLC)
- Administrative Agent (UBS AG, Stamford Branch)
- Original credit agreement date (March 11, 2020)
- Restricted payment amount (up to $37.5 million)
- Payment deadline (January 31, 2021)
- Amendment fee (0.175% of outstanding term loan principal)
- CFO name (Charles Jehl)
- Governing law (New York State)
- Key covenant requirements (Total Net Leverage compliance on pro forma basis)
- Lender entities (BlackRock entities, TCP/Tennenbaum funds, American Money Management CLOs, etc.)

The memo appropriately indicates "N/A" for terms not disclosed in the amendment document (such as interest rates, maturity dates, and loan amounts) rather than fabricating information. All substantive financial and legal terms are accurately extracted from the source material.

ANSWER: YES

MISSING_TERMS: 
- Original credit agreement date (March 11, 2020) - mentioned in memo but not prominently featured in key terms
- Specific leverage covenant details referenced in Section 7.11 of the original credit agreement
- Term loan structure and amounts (amendment references "Term Loans" but no principal amounts disclosed)
- Administrative agent costs and expenses reimbursement obligation per Section 10.04
- Complete lender list with their specific commitments/holdings (memo mentions lender categories but not the full detailed breakdown of all participating entities and their roles)
